children: Motilal Oswal's research report on HDFC Bank

Mr. Sashidhar Jagdishan has decided to not seek his reappointment as MD & CEO of HDFC Bank and shall retire on 26th Oct’26. The board will thus fast-track the process of selection and appointment of his successor. With Mr. Jagdishan’s decision not to seek reappointment, along with the upcoming superannuation of CFO Mr. Srinivasan Vaidyanathan on 30th Nov’26 and other recent changes in the leadership team (please refer to Exhibits 3 & 4), the bank will witness several changes in the key management personnel. Mr. Bhavin Lakhpatwala, Head of Strategy and IR, has also resigned earlier in Jun’26 and joined RBL Bank as CFO. Mr. Puneet Sharma, former Axis Bank CFO, is scheduled to take charge as CFO-designate of HDFC Bank on 1st Sep’26. Mr. Rajiv Kumar, ex-Chief Election Commissioner and ex-Finance Secretary, has recently taken charge as the new Chairman of the bank after the sudden exit of Mr. Atanu Chakraborty. The decision on MD & CEO was amongst the key matters on which deliberations were going on at the senior most level and clarity was awaited by the street. HDFCB stock also corrected 18% in the past six months amid ongoing uncertainty.

We estimate HDFCB to deliver an improved earnings performance from FY28 onward, while RoA should sustain at ~1.8%. We revise our TP to INR925 (1.8x FY28E ABV + INR128 for subs) and maintain our BUY rating.
